name: Fireflies.ai
description: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that joins video calls, dialers, and uploaded audio/video files to transcribe, summarize, and search conversations, with conversation-intelligence analytics, task and contact tracking, and role-specific AI Skills for sales, recruiting, and other teams.
best_for: Teams across sales, recruiting, marketing, and other functions that want a free-to-start AI meeting notetaker with broad video/dialer coverage, conversation-intelligence analytics, and CRM or project-management integrations.
features: AI Notetaker Bot (fred@fireflies.ai) that auto-joins calendar meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and 10+ other platforms to record, transcribe, and summarize
Transcription in 100+ languages with speaker recognition and automatic language detection
AskFred, a conversational AI assistant that answers questions about past meeting content
Conversation intelligence analytics -- speaker talk-time tracking, sentiment analysis, and topic trackers -- on the Business plan and above
Live Assist, providing real-time suggestions, coaching, and answers during live meetings
200+ AI Skills for automated, role-specific outputs (such as follow-up emails or candidate scoring) across sales, recruiting, marketing, and other functions
Fireflies MCP Server bringing meeting insights into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools
Dialer and API support for transcribing calls from Aircall and RingCentral, plus uploaded audio/video files
CRM, project-management, and applicant-tracking integrations, including Greenhouse and Lever for recruiting teams

pricing.starting_price: $10/seat/month, billed annually (Pro plan; $18/month billed monthly) — Free plan also available

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Free forever, for individuals starting out. Listed as "Unlimited transcription*" (asterisked on the pricing page) but limited to 400 minutes of shared team storage and 20 AI credits/month, with only limited AI summaries. Includes the notetaker bot, 100+ language transcription, meeting search, AskFred, desktop/mobile apps, Chrome extension, and API access.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $18/seat/month if billed monthly. Unlimited transcription and AI summaries, 8,000 minutes of storage/seat, 20 AI credits. Adds video recording, downloadable transcripts/recordings, Personal/Email Assistants, AI Skills, Voice Agents, and unlimited integrations.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: $29/seat/month if billed monthly. Marked "Most Popular." Unlimited storage, 30 AI credits. Adds multi-language mode, conversation intelligence, team analytics for admins, public meeting access, and user groups. Volume discounts available for more than 50 seats.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Marked "ANNUAL ONLY" on the pricing page (no separate monthly rate). Unlimited storage, 50 AI credits. Adds a rules engine, SSO + SCIM, API audit logs, HIPAA compliance, private storage, custom data retention, transcript-and-summary-only mode, a super admin role, and a dedicated account manager. The page's call-to-action for this tier is still "Contact Us" rather than self-serve signup.

pros: Genuine free-forever plan with unlimited transcription (subject to a shared 400-minute team storage cap and 20 monthly AI credits), not just a time-limited trial
Publishes exact per-seat pricing, both monthly and annual, for Pro, Business, and even its Enterprise tier ($39/seat/month, annual only), rather than gating all pricing behind a sales call
States SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance company-wide, per its security section, with HIPAA compliance and private storage specifically available on its Enterprise tier
cons: The Free plan's "unlimited transcription" claim is asterisked and constrained in practice by a shared 400-minute team storage limit and only 20 AI credits per month

HIPAA compliance, private storage, and custom data retention are listed only under the Enterprise tier in the plan-comparison table, even though the homepage's broader security section markets HIPAA compliance as a general capability

Enterprise pricing is published as $39/seat/month, but its call-to-action is still "Contact Us" rather than self-serve signup, and teams above 50 seats are directed to contact sales for volume discounts regardless of tier

faq.question: Can I use Fireflies for free?
faq.answer: Yes. Its pricing page lists a "Free forever" plan with unlimited transcription (asterisked), limited AI summaries, 400 minutes of shared team storage, and 20 AI credits per month.

faq.question: How much does Fireflies cost?
faq.answer: On annual billing, Pro is $10/seat/month, Business is $19/seat/month, and Enterprise is $39/seat/month (annual only). Monthly billing is available for Pro ($18) and Business ($29) at higher rates.

faq.question: Is Fireflies SOC 2 compliant?
faq.answer: Its security section states SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance, while HIPAA compliance and private storage are specifically listed as Enterprise-tier features on its plan-comparison table.

alternatives.name: Otter.ai
alternatives.description: An AI conversational knowledge engine that automatically transcribes meetings, interviews, and conversations into searchable summaries with action items and speaker identification.
alternatives.best_for: Teams and individuals across sales, education, and media wanting automatic transcription with a chat-based search assistant.

alternatives.name: Fathom
alternatives.description: An AI meeting notetaker that records and transcribes video calls and generates instant AI summaries immediately afterward, with CRM sync and coaching scorecards on paid plans.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a free-forever individual plan plus CRM field sync and AI coaching scorecards on higher tiers.
strengths: CRM field sync and Deal View

alternatives.name: Gong
alternatives.description: A revenue intelligence platform that captures and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings to surface deal risk, coach reps, and inform forecasting.
alternatives.best_for: Sales organizations wanting deal-risk scoring and org-wide forecasting built on top of captured conversations, not just per-call notes.
strengths: Rep coaching grounded in real calls
